mapper.select: select ifnull((select sum(total_amount) from team_payment),0) as totalRevenue
select floor(ifnull((select sum(total_amount) from team_payment), 0) * 0.08) as totalProfitTeam
select ifnull(sum(total_amount), 0) as month_revenue from team_payment where year(approved_at) = year(curdate()) and month(approved_at) = month(curdate())
select floor(ifnull(sum(total_amount), 0) * 0.08) as month_revenue from team_payment where year(approved_at) = year(curdate()) and month(approved_at) = month(curdate())

select ifnull(sum(total_amount), 0) as month_revenue from team_payment where approved_at >= date_format(curdate(), '%Y-%m-01') - interval #{n} month and approved_at < date_format(curdate(), '%Y-%m-01') - interval #{n} month + Interval 1 month

select floor(ifnull(sum(total_amount), 0)*0.08) as month_revenue from team_payment where approved_at >= date_format(curdate(), '%Y-%m-01') - interval #{n} month and approved_at < date_format(curdate(), '%Y-%m-01') - interval #{n} month + Interval 1 month
select count(*) as period_cnt from team_payment where approved_at >= #{startDate} and approved_at < #{endDate} + interval 1 day
select ifnull(sum(total_amount), 0) as month_revenue from team_payment where approved_at >= #{startDate} and approved_at < #{endDate} + interval 1 day
select floor(ifnull(sum(total_amount), 0)*0.08) as month_revenue from team_payment where approved_at >= #{startDate} and approved_at < #{endDate} + interval 1 day
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO team_payment ( order_id, payment_key, order_name, payment_status, payment_method, total_amount, balance, currency, card_company, card_number, installment_months, easy_payment_provider, receipt_url, requested_at, approved_at, raw_response ) VALUES ( #{orderId}, #{paymentKey}, #{orderName}, #{paymentStatus}, #{paymentMethod}, #{totalAmount}, #{balance}, #{currency}, #{cardCompany}, #{cardNumber}, #{installmentMonths}, #{easyPaymentProvider}, #{receiptUrl}, #{requestedAt}, #{approvedAt}, #{rawResponse} )
mapper.select: SELECT m.* FROM team_payment tp JOIN team_match_participant p ON p.payment_id = tp.payment_id JOIN team_match m ON m.team_match_id = p.team_match_id WHERE tp.payment_key = #{paymentKey}

select count(*) from team_match_participant where team_match_id = #{matchId} and status = '결제완료' and team_id = (select team_id from team_user where user_id = #{userId} and team_role = '주장' and withdrawn = 0 limit 1)
